doc.title: Greg Thomas interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 2014

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Thomas and wishes him luck with his Albert Murray work.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well you’re a good advocate for the music.
This is obvious, but you know what you’re talking about, and that’s — we want the advocates to know what they’re talking about.
